title: Join the fleet operating block as the eighth repository
summary: Insert the v8 fleet-operating block (digest 5e543eb84584c382) into CLAUDE.md, restructure the repository profile under the four standard headings, add the operating-block digest job to ci.yml, and commit .claude/settings.json with OPUM_HOOK_ACTOR/OPUM_HOOK_ACCOUNTABLE_HUMAN so the plugin's hooks can write to this repo's tracker. User decision, asked via AskUserQuestion 2026-09-07: opum-marketplace joins the fleet operating block and stays dev-only. Note: OMARK-10 is reserved by draft PR #18 (fix/OMARK-10-notify-orchestrator-fixture), not yet on dev, so this task used an explicit --id to avoid colliding with it.
